svg.aria-label: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenCode report to one board and their steps tick live; Codex asks whether to open its pull request and one key copies the answer; a message written on the board’s page reaches Codex and its reply shows, a preview coming in 0.24.3; one npx command connects every agent, on npm from 0.24.0
svg.font-family: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans TC', 'Noto Sans SC', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif
svg.title: Agent Board: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenCode report to one board and their steps tick live; Codex asks whether to open its pull request and one key copies the answer; a message written on the board’s page reaches Codex and its reply shows, a preview coming in 0.24.3; one npx command connects every agent, on npm from 0.24.0

g.text: Each one reports in by itself,
so you stop checking each window.
Each step shows up the moment
The agent that needs you comes first,
Pick the question and press y:
the answer is copied for Codex.
Write to Codex from the board
in your browser, and see it reply.
One board for every coding agent:
what waits on you comes first.
